senses.gloss: f. (v. חָצָב) a stand for a pitcher, tripod.—כח׳ in the shape of a tripod, triangulary arranged.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 25a:14">B. Mets. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>כח׳ מהו</he> (Ms. H. <he>כחוצבא</he>) if coins are found lying in a triangle; (Y. ib. II, 8ᵇ, sq. <he>מצובה</he>, expl. <cite ref="S02138"><he>קרפיפא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 83b">B. Bath. 83ᵇ</cite> (also <he>כחצובא</he>) planted in a triangle.

<cite ref="Eruvin 85b:4">Erub. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>דקיימי כח׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דעבידת כי חציבא</he>, read: <cite ref="H01506"><he>חצובא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the three ruins between two buildings stand in a triangle (so as to make only the central ruin equally near to both dwellings).
